answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the tide of a task receipt, and the dune is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The violet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
